original_work: All chapter games, payoff transfers and exact prompt/solution pairs are original instructional constructions. Full finite proofs are supplied within their stated scope, including the perfection equivalence omitted in the inspected Manea section.
prior_proof_interface: C04 proved finite-dimensional Kakutani is used to establish finite mixed Nash and perturbed existence, without invoking Nash to prove that same fixed-point input.
runtime_boundary: Only the final HTML/checker/source record/author review are runtime inputs. Fourteen retained outside-book artifacts and the preparation/blueprint are provenance only.
excluded_claims: No whole-PDF inspection or unrestricted infinite-game/Bayesian theorem.
No automatic extensive-form or sequential-perfection equivalence.
No learning, empirical identification, unique selection or cardinal welfare invariance inferred from an equilibrium label.
